set.body: Rename exported frame() to compile_frame() before release. De-export factor_frame(), nonlinear_query(), and compile_lowering() until supported public workflows exist. Decide whether low-level result constructors are internal or a documented developer API. Canonically rebuild and validate mutable-by-convention values at every public consumer, including numerical_agreement(), and regenerate all documentation/examples. Every export must lead to an implemented workflow.
set.title: Narrow the 0.1 public API and harden value consumption
